Game Overview

Colosseum Battle is a casual title where step into the epic Colosseum, where survival hinges on your warrior skills. Face waves of fierce tigers in a thrilling, high-stakes arena battle. Test your mettle and become a legend as you strive to outlast the relentless onslaught. How long will you endure?
